verdict.rationale: An in-browser toolbar is a fair question for a deployment and hosting platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a toolbar overlay on live sites for feedback, feature-flag management, or performance inspection. The general 'built-in observability' claim is a dashboard-side feature, not an on-site toolbar, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an in-browser toolbar to leave feedback, manage feature flags, and inspect performance directly on my live site
